meta.title: Unidad 10
meta.subtitle: Lee la pista y adivina de qué se habla

questions.question: It uses flashing lights when it drives on busy streets.
It can move up and down inside a building.
It has blades and turns when the wind blows.
It sends electricity to homes in our town.
It is when there are too many cars on the road and they cannot move.
The doors close after you go inside it to travel underground.
A place with many wind turbines working together to make energy.
It is a big red truck that helps put out fires.
It is when people share a ride in one car to go to school or work.
Which of these help us travel? Choose ALL the correct answers.
Which of these make clean energy? Choose ALL the correct answers.
